analysis.session_summary: The session was defined by a broad, catalyst-light dollar decline: DXY fell 0.38% and VIX eased 1.57%, lifting G10 risk FX led by NZD (+0.31%) and EUR (+0.24%). BOJ Governor Ueda’s comments triggered only a 0.066% JPY impulse that fully faded, leaving JPY the weakest major at -0.29%. Ivey PMI missed at 58.2 vs 65.2 but CAD’s reaction was muted inside the noise floor. No calendar events are due ahead, leaving headline-driven flows in control.

themes.theme: Broad dollar weakness without a fundamental anchor

themes.evidence: BOJ Gov Ueda Speaks at 08:35 produced JPY stronger by 0.066%, but JPY day ended -0.291% and gave back 95% of its peak
NZD strength +0.31%, AUD/NZD -0.312%, NZD/USD +0.56%, no own releases

currency_drivers.USD: No US data or policy catalyst; dollar fell broadly with DXY -0.38% and VIX easing.
currency_drivers.EUR: No euro-area catalyst; euro held its range and rose with risk appetite, up 0.24%.
currency_drivers.JPY: BOJ Ueda sparked only a 0.066% JPY impulse that reversed; finished weakest with no follow-through.
currency_drivers.GBP: No UK catalyst; sterling selling was rejected and recovered 90% from its lows.
currency_drivers.AUD: No domestic catalyst; a +0.08% attempt was rejected and gave back 65%.
currency_drivers.CAD: Ivey PMI missed at 58.2 vs 65.2 but CAD recovered 88% from lows; reaction muted.
currency_drivers.CHF: No Swiss catalyst; CHF attempt to lead was rejected and gave back 82%.
currency_drivers.NZD: No releases; NZD held its range and led G10 at +0.31%.

leg_notes.EUR/USD: EUR/USD's four legs netted +54.9 pips with no catalyst assigned to any leg: early up, mid-session dip, strong up-leg, then late fade.

polarity_reads.read: The 0.066% JPY impulse was real but unscored and fully faded; positioning does not chase hawkish BOJ rhetoric.
The 58.2 vs 65.2 miss produced only a 0.023% basket move inside noise; CAD positioning was indifferent to the data.

scenarios.name: Risk-on continuation
scenarios.thesis: Broad dollar weakness persists as VIX stays contained and China-EU optimism holds.
scenarios.invalidation: DXY closes back above its daily midpoint and VIX turns higher.

pair_paths.rationale: EUR and USD contributions both favor upside; today's full range is the next objective.
GBP selling was rejected and recovered 90%; a break of the range targets the day's range.
NZD led G10 and held its range with no catalyst; continuation uses the daily range.

scenarios.name: BOJ repricing / JPY squeeze
scenarios.thesis: Markets revisit BOJ hike path after Ueda, squeezing JPY shorts.
scenarios.invalidation: JPY impulse fades again and USD/JPY holds above 158.157.

pair_paths.rationale: The full daily range is the natural target for a fresh JPY repricing.
CHF/JPY's wider daily range captures the cross's sensitivity to JPY strength.

scenarios.name: Rangebound consolidation
scenarios.thesis: Catalyst-light markets consolidate inside today's ranges.
scenarios.invalidation: A fresh risk-positive catalyst breaks EUR/USD above today's high.

pair_paths.rationale: Trade within the 79.1-pip daily range until a catalyst emerges.
USD/JPY stays inside its 47.5-pip range as BOJ and USD impulses offset.

risks.risk: BOJ Ueda impulse proves to be the start of a hawkish repricing
risks.why_it_matters: JPY is weakest despite a clear hike signal, leaving asymmetric upside if markets follow through.
risks.watch: BOJ commentary, JGB yields, USD/JPY close above 158.157

risks.risk: Risk-on dollar decline reverses on headline fatigue
risks.why_it_matters: The dollar drop had no obvious fundamental anchor; high-beta longs are crowded.
risks.watch: VIX reversal and DXY reclaim of 101.61

analysis.calendar_ahead_note: No scheduled calendar events in the coming window; headline risk and BOJ/Fed speak remain the key catalysts.
